summary.text: Jim Prokopiak is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 140 who has served since March 18, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney who previously served as a Falls Township supervisor.

paragraphs.text: Jim Prokopiak lives in Levittown, Pennsylvania, and earned degrees from West Chester University and Temple School of Law.
His career experience includes working as an attorney representing railroad workers who were injured on the job.
From 2002 to 2009, he served as a Falls Township supervisor, and Ballotpedia also lists prior service on the Pennsbury School District school board.
Prokopiak assumed office on March 18, 2024, succeeding John Galloway.
For the 2024-2025 session, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as Aging & Older Adult Services, Education, Local Government, and Tourism & Recreational Development.
